item.title: Batavia-based Henry H. Cook Plumbing, Heating, Electrical closes
item.description: After three decades of taking care of the plumbing, heating, and electrical needs of residents and businesses in Genesee County, Henry H. Cook has closed, owner Tammy Cook announced on Wednesday.Cook declined to comment further on the decision to close.

item.title: Batavia connects with countywide resources to help students' mental health, behavioral needs
item.description: After providing mental, emotional and behavioral support to students in-house, Batavia City School District has taken steps to fulfill its needs with resources throughout Genesee County, Jackson Primary Principal Maureen Notaro says.

item.title: One BCSD board member says preliminary budget with 3.19% tax levy increase would be 'asking too much'
item.description: A preliminary budget that includes a $7 million general fund increase, 12 additional staff, a BOCES capital project and collective bargaining agreements seems a bit too much to swallow at first blush, Batavia City School board member Alice Benedict says.
